Messages.Author: Spiridonas
Messages.Body:
Dawn Operation + Drawing out the beast vs. Combat Ends

Assume all above at superior.

An action is blocked and D.O. is played. Before range is determined DOtB
is played. The opposing minion plays a combat ends card,
Majisty,Elysium,etc.

D O States:All damage inflicted to all vampires in the resulting combat is
agg.

DOtB States:(Sup.)As above, and opposing vampire takes one damage AFTER
each round. This damage cannot be prevented.

Q:Would this one nonprevent damage delt be agg. AFTER the round combat
ends is played.ie-is this a leagle combo.

ALSO: per new errata,can pulled fangs be played on that damage.

Thanks for any input.

Mike C.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
spiri...@aol.com (Spiridonas) writes:
>Dawn Operation + Drawing out the beast vs. Combat Ends
>Assume all above at superior.

>An action is blocked and D.O. is played. Before range is determined DOtB

>is played. The opposing minion plays a combat ends card, Majesty,Elysium,etc.

>DOtB States:(Sup.)As above, and opposing vampire takes one damage AFTER
>each round. This damage cannot be prevented.

The damage occurs at the end of the round. (Errata/ruling).

>Q:Would this one nonprevent damage delt be agg. AFTER the round combat
>ends is played.ie-is this a leagle combo.

The one damage would be applied when the round ended (prematurely
in this case), and it would be aggravated due to D.O.

>ALSO: per new errata,can pulled fangs be played on that damage.

Yes. (Unless DOtB's damage isn't counted for Pulled Fangs - a la
damage from retainers - but I don't think that that is the case).

Messages.Author: Pheersum
Messages.Body:
Combat ends--ends combat immediately before damage is dealt or a
strike's effects take place.
Vampire would take damage after each round, but round isn't finished.
End of round, strike resolution, all the remaining combat phases are
skipped, and combat is over.
That's my take.
